mapper.select: SELECT p.pact_id, p.contract_no, p.contract_name, p.contract_type, p.party_a, p.party_b, p.contract_amount, p.sign_date, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status, p.execution_status, p.is_manual_modify, p.dept_id, p.emp_id, p.template_config_id, p.main_attach_id, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS dept_name, COALESCE(e.emp_phone, '') AS emp_phone FROM pact_main p LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON p.emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON p.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE p.pact_id = #{id}

SELECT p.pact_id, p.contract_no, p.contract_name, p.contract_type, p.party_a, p.party_b, p.contract_amount, p.sign_date, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status, p.execution_status, p.is_manual_modify, p.dept_id, p.emp_id, p.template_config_id, p.main_attach_id, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS dept_name, COALESCE(e.emp_phone, '') AS emp_phone FROM pact_main p LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON p.emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON p.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE p.contract_no = #{contractNo}

SELECT pact_id, contract_no, contract_name, contract_type, party_a, party_b, contract_amount, sign_date, start_date, end_date, status, execution_status, dept_id, emp_id, template_config_id, main_attach_id, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time FROM pact_main WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT pact_id, contract_no, contract_name, contract_type, party_a, party_b, contract_amount, sign_date, start_date, end_date, status, execution_status, dept_id, emp_id, template_config_id, main_attach_id, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time FROM pact_main ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT pact_id, contract_no, contract_name, contract_type, party_a, party_b, contract_amount, sign_date, start_date, end_date, status, execution_status, dept_id, emp_id, template_config_id, main_attach_id, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time FROM pact_main ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT pact_id, contract_no, contract_name, contract_type, party_a, party_b, contract_amount, sign_date, start_date, end_date, status, execution_status, dept_id, emp_id, template_config_id, main_attach_id, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time FROM pact_main WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pact_main WHERE status = #{status}

SELECT DISTINCT p.pact_id, p.contract_no, p.contract_name, p.contract_type, p.party_a, p.party_b, p.contract_amount, p.sign_date, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status, p.execution_status, p.dept_id, p.emp_id, p.template_config_id, p.main_attach_id, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM pact_main p INNER JOIN wf_process_instance pi ON pi.business_key = p.contract_no AND pi.business_type = 'CONTRACT' INNER JOIN wf_process_task pt ON pi.instance_id = pt.process_instance_id WHERE pt.assignee_user_id = #{userId} AND pt.task_status = 'PENDING' AND p.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT MAX(contract_no) FROM pact_main WHERE contract_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pact_main (contract_no, contract_name, contract_type, party_a, party_b, contract_amount, sign_date, start_date, end_date, status, execution_status, is_manual_modify, dept_id, emp_id, template_config_id, main_attach_id, remark, create_user) VALUES (#{contractNo}, #{contractName}, #{contractType}, #{partyA}, #{partyB}, #{contractAmount}, #{signDate}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{executionStatus}, #{isManualModify}, #{deptId}, #{empId}, #{templateConfigId}, #{mainAttachId}, #{remark}, #{createUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE pact_main SET execution_status = 'EXECUTING', update_time = #{now} WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND execution_status = 'PENDING_EXECUTION' AND (is_manual_modify = 0 OR is_manual_modify IS NULL) AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date <= #{now}

UPDATE pact_main SET execution_status = 'COMPLETED', update_time = #{now} WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND execution_status = 'EXECUTING' AND (is_manual_modify = 0 OR is_manual_modify IS NULL) AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date <= #{now}
